ticket: Releases wait for Jason only for a high-risk Tier 4 or a data_reason change (ruling 1): no other holds, no other review emails
title: Releases wait for the Founder only when they must: an incomplete look is asked again, adding rows no longer holds, the review email tells the truth
why: Jason's ruling 1, confirmed 2026-11-28 14:10 UTC through the session manager: "I shouldnt" be required to review these. Gate: every launch gate's releases pass through this pipeline (0181 §1), and three of today's releases (#331, #332, #333) stopped on the check's own sign-in, not on the release.

changes.what: When the before-and-after check can't judge a release (the test accounts couldn't sign in), the site asks for the look again, three looks in all, each known by its run. It no longer goes to the Founder for review. If the third look still can't judge it, the release stays on staging, unpublished, and an Audit ticket goes to the IT Manager's lane with the report's link. A look that passes or blocks is acted on as before. A release never goes live unchecked.

A migration that only adds rows no longer keeps a release in the daily batch. One that changes or removes rows (UPDATE or DELETE, the ones with a data_reason) still waits for the Founder, and a high-risk territory still stops first as a Decision Brief.
The "waiting for your review" email says "its checks passed" only when the before-and-after check passed, and says why the release waits for the Founder. It is not sent for an incomplete look.

tier4: The release pipeline's own rules (Releases, BeforeAfter, ReleaseKind): the Founder's ruling 1, 2026-11-28. No money, security, private-data or 0066 check is changed
